description: issue #690: `note` (Sound profile, arity 2) schedules one pitched sound at the current tempo and emits exactly one `sound` event with payload {command:"note", pitch, duration}. Duration is in beats, never wall-clock (spec/execution-model.md's headless trace stream), and the runtime models sound as scheduling + event emission, never a real audio device, so this event is emitted unconditionally even in a muted environment (spec/interaction-events.md's `note` section). The `sound` event follows the instruction event ("Sound commands emit `sound` events after sound state has been scheduled").
